column1: # bg_essence.tsv - a essencia MECANICA de cada antecedente de PICKER_LIST["background"]
# (SPEC T764, I105b, R8). Colunas: nome_EN <TAB> jogo <TAB> livro <TAB> pag impressa <TAB>
# UMA LINHA POR (nome, livro). Um nome que aparece em 2 JOGOS gera 2 linhas, e e a comparacao
# entre elas que decide o dedupe de I105b - a decisao sai DESTA tabela, nao de memoria (R8).
# Medido em 2026-08-28 sobre os despejos -layout -enc UTF-8 de research/README.md (armadilhas
# 8 e 9), cortando na calha. Paginas sao IMPRESSAS.
# jogo: Vampire | Mage | Werewolf. E o eixo de I105b ("Origem = o jogo, nao o livro") - por isso
# core, da, hh, anarch e bh sao todos `Vampire` e nao geram homonimo entre si.
# 2a PASSADA, mesma data: o user pos `Mago/Mage - The Ascension` (o M20 EM INGLES, no lugar do
# M20.pdf PT) e a pasta `Werewolf/` inteira. As 27 linhas Mage foram REFEITAS sobre o livro
# ingles - e nao so o texto mudou de fonte, a PAGINA mudou: a edicao PT ordena a lista pelo nome
# PORTUGUES, entao `Library`/`Biblioteca` era p.309 no PT e e p.318 no EN. As paginas abaixo sao
# as do livro INGLES, que e o que I21 bloco 1 tem de imprimir.
# NAO HA MAIS BURACO DE FONTE. Os 5 nomes que a 1a passada deixou com `?` (Ancestors, Fetish,
# Kinfolk, Pure Breed, Rites) estao medidos em `w20` 135-140, e `Totem` agora tem os DOIS lados.
# ================ A DECISAO DE DEDUPE DE I105b, TIRADA DESTA TABELA ================
# 15 dos 46 nomes aparecem em MAIS DE UM JOGO. Um a um:
# 1 ITEM (mecanica igual nos jogos, so muda a ambientacao):
#   Allies · Alternate Identity · Contacts · Fame · Influence · Library · Mentor · Rank ·
#   Sao tracos do mundo MORTAL que os livros descrevem do mesmo jeito - dinheiro, informantes,
#   um mais-velho que orienta, um posto numa hierarquia. `Resources` chega a repetir a frase
#   ("actual cash, but as this Background increases...") em V20 p.115 e W20 p.138. Um sufixo
#   `(Origem)` aqui nao separaria mecanica nenhuma, so encheria a lista.
#   V20 p.118 = pe dentro da comunidade KINDRED, e o Status vem do senhor e da linhagem na
#   Camarilla ou da matilha no Saba. M20 p.325 = respeito entre os pares DESPERTOS, e so em 4-5
#   pontos alcanca grupos aliados. Duas escadas sociais diferentes, e uma nao converte na outra.
#   E o exemplo que o proprio user deu em I105b. Werewolf NAO tem Status (tem Renome, que e
#   outro eixo) entao nao ha um terceiro irmao.
#   (hh p.123 e uma TERCEIRA escada - a Society of Leopold - mas hh e Vampire, e I105b manda
#   dividir por JOGO, nao por livro, entao ela nao gera um 3o item.)
#   M20 p.326 = pacto PESSOAL com um espirito ajudante, comprado pelo personagem. W20 p.140 =
#   "a Background that applies directly to the character's PACK, rather than the individual",
#   e a matilha inteira poe os pontos num totem so. O que se compra e diferente (um espirito
#   seu contra um espirito do grupo) e quem paga e diferente. Esta era a linha que a 1a passada
#   deixou em aberto por falta do livro de Werewolf; com w20 no disco ela fecha em DOIS.
# Os 4 nomes so-de-Werewolf (Ancestors · Fetish · Kinfolk · Pure Breed) e o `Rites` NAO geram
# homonimo: nenhum outro jogo reivindica esses nomes (V20 tem `Rituals`, que e outro nome).
# ==> LISTA FINAL: 47 itens + o vazio (45 de origem, `Status` e `Totem` valendo 2 cada).
# ================ 2 ACHADOS QUE A MEDICAO TROUXE JUNTO ================
# a) O livro escreve `Artifact` e `Requisition` no SINGULAR (hh p.140 e p.134); a lista da ficha
#    usa o plural. O user DECIDIU manter o plural (2026-08-28) e a lista nao foi renomeada.
# b) hh p.122 traz 2 antecedentes que a lista nao carrega: `Mob` (comanda uma turba de 2 a 25
#    pessoas) e `Reliquary` (acesso a uma reliquia da Igreja; perde-la consome os pontos). W20
#    traz outros 2: `Fate` (w20 p.137) e `Spirit Heritage` (w20 p.139). Incluir qualquer um
#    seria alargar I105a, que so mandou entrar `Artifacts` - nao entraram.

column5: essencia
Mortals who help you willingly, without coaxing; may lend their own Backgrounds and indirect access to their contacts, influence and resources.
Mortals who support you willingly, without coercion, and are not always available when you call.
Folks who have your back in time of need - badass friends, helpful animals, people who owe you.
People who help and support you out of love or common interest - family, friends, or a group that owes you.
A second persona with papers and documentation; dots buy how deep the cover runs and how much recognition it carries.
A complete alternate identity with proper documentation for the period.
An identity to disappear into, meant for shapechangers, clones and people in dangerous professions.
Contact with the spirits of the Garou who came before; the rating is how readily an ancestor answers and lends what it knew.
The fine art of disappearing: records get lost, cameras glitch, people fail to place you; the Technocratic side is Cloaking.
A stocked and maintained weapons cache; each dot buys more potent weapons plus the ammunition and upkeep to keep them fire-ready.
Same trait reprinted for Anarch characters: a functional armory plus the ability to maintain every weapon in it.
Printed `Artifact`, singular. Arcanum trait: begin play owning a supernaturally potent item, its power set by the dots.
The Awakened self; the rating measures it, sets how much Quintessence the mage can hold and shift, and how real it feels; the Technocratic side is Genius.
You can call in the cavalry and expect help, in a limited capacity, through your membership in an organization.
A secure HQ the hunter owns; points are split across three categories - Luxury, Size and Security.
In an age of permits for everything, the right certifications open the doors the paperwork guards.
A stronghold shared with like-minded associates that pools territory, resources and mutual defense; the Technocratic side is Construct.
People you bribe, manipulate or coerce for information; dots buy the reach of the network plus a few major Contacts.
People you manipulate or coerce into offering information, with minor contacts spread around.
People who know things - not as helpful or reliable as Allies, but they help you dig things up.
Acquaintances from all walks of life who do not mind telling you what is going on.
Devotees who go past friendship: they trust you and act on your word.
The mage's mind is her castle: a world of her own making that she can retreat into.
You are a Chosen One with a part to play in the cosmic drama; prophecy hints at your coming greatness.
Physical territory whose access you control FOR FEEDING; dots buy its size and the strength of the claim.
Feeding territory your character controls, held by leave of the local Prince or elder Cainite.
Conduits to cosmic consciousness that feed the mage insight she did not study for; the Technocratic side is Hypercram.
Enlightened hypertech grafted into living tissue - cyborg implants or genetic biomods - in one of three declared configurations.
Recognition in mortal society; dots buy privileges and how far you can sway public opinion.
Widespread recognition as entertainer, scholar, warrior or criminal.
You are famous within the Sleeper world, for a story-based reason.
An animal ally bound to the mage, in the classic witch's-cat mold; the Technocratic side is Companion.
You own a fetish - a physical object with a spirit bound into it, and the spirit is what grants the object its powers.
Purity of the blood and closeness to the First Vampire; without dots you start as 13th Generation.
Same trait, medieval era: purity of blood and proximity to the First Vampire.
Tal'Mahe'Ra variant: the sect does not recruit the weak, so its characters run to lower Generation.
A spiritual entity that aids the hunter through dreams, signs and portents, with hidden motives and a price of its own.
A group of mortals you feed from without fear; dots buy how much blood per night and what minor tasks they will run.
A group of mortals to feed on safely, useful for minor tasks besides nourishment.
Pull in the mortal community through wealth, office or blackmail; dots buy how far you sway political and social process.
Pull in the mortal community through wealth, lineage, prestige, politics or blackmail.
Attention and respect within the Sleepers' world - celebrity, gang boss, politician, cult leader.
Contact with the humans and wolves descended from Garou who did not inherit the spiritual duty; dots buy how many and how useful.
Humanity's collective imagination focuses on you; you carry a mythic reputation you did not ask for.
Arcanum trait: the research difficulty number drops by the rating, and it does not stack with Axis Mundi access.
A collection of books and files worth having in the Internet age; dots buy how far the archive reaches.
A Kindred or group of Kindred who guides and aids you now and then; dots buy their power and reach.
A Cainite or group of Cainites who look out for you with guidance and occasional aid.
Arcanum trait: the Elder Brother or Sister who initiated you; the rating is their standing and your starting reputation.
An elder mage who took an interest in you and provides training, guidance and occasional assistance.
A Garou of higher Rank who has taken an interest in you and will look after you, up to a point; the rating is how powerful the mentor is.
A place of gathered Quintessence where the mage meditates to restore her inner reserves.
Meditate on an earlier incarnation for help with the situation at hand: once per session the Background pool is added to another task's pool.
A faction player who moves you as a piece and conceals his face from the pawns.
Descent from renowned Garou forbears; the rating is the standing that ancestry alone buys in Garou society.
Position in a government agency's chain of command; the Rank difference is a Social bonus inside the agency and counts two dots lower outside it.
A title of some distinction among the masses - military rank, religious office, executive position.
Printed `Requisition`, singular. A pool of equipment points per story equal to the dots; no single item above (Rank + 2), and surviving gear goes back at story's end.
The epic materiel a Technocratic operative can draw on, by chart of cost.
Assets you control - cash, property, investments, criminal infrastructure; dots buy holdings and monthly income.
Assets the character controls: gold, investments, property, commercial inventory.
Arcanum trait: the society houses new members at about one dot; anything above that comes from family or another job.
Money made from magick, and the Syndicate's side of it; dots buy income and holdings.
Access to and control over valuable assets - cash at first, then investments and property as the rating climbs.
Loyal servants and companions, often ghouls or repeatedly Dominated mortals; dots buy how many and how capable.
Servants, assistants and steadfast companions, mostly ghouls.
Tal'Mahe'Ra variant: the ghoul servitors come from the three revenant lines that have served the sect for centuries.
A faithful retainer who patches you up and covers the chores.
How many rites the character knows at the start of play; the rating is the count, not a level of skill.
Sabbat only: knowledge of the ritae; without this Background a Pack Priest's ritae simply do not work.
A place to get away from the consensual reality that hinders your Arts; the Technocratic side is the Laboratory.
Access to Q Division experimental technology; a new device is issued on a roll against this Background.
Little birds in various nests keep you informed; the informants are not necessarily your friends.
Standing in the local KINDRED community - Camarilla status runs from sire and bloodline, Sabbat status from pack and zeal.
Standing as an Inquisitor inside the SOCIETY OF LEOPOLD, earned by dedicated work or by a notable kill.
Respect within your chosen AWAKENED group; at 4-5 dots it reaches allied groups and outside your faction.
A personal pact with a spirit helper, in the shamanic mold; each side of the pact gets something.
A PACK trait, not a personal one: the pack pools all the points into one totem spirit and shares what it grants.
An item that carries Sphere Effects of its own - Talisman, Device, Fetish, Charm; the Storyteller sets form and function.
